in_sanskrit.name: Munna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector, Guardian
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Munna एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Sanskrit root 'muna', meaning 'to protect'. Munna is a name of reverence and respect, symbolizing one who shields and guards.

in_hindi.name: मुन्ना
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Munna is a Hindi language pet name or nickname for a child. It is a term of endearment and means 'little one'. Munna is often used as a short form of the name Murli, Mukesh, or other names that begin with the letter 'M'. In Hindi culture, Munna is a popular name for boys and is often used as a pet name for infants and young children.

in_tamil.name: Munna
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Protector, Guardian
in_tamil.long_meaning: Munna ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। From the Sanskrit root 'muna', meaning 'to protect'. Munna is a name of reverence and respect, symbolizing one who shields and guards.
